mono.usage: Data, KPIs, coordinates, live metrics, status codes

structure.map: Full viewport absolute positioning. Occupies 100% width and height.
structure.header: Floating at the top, z-index 50, crystal glassmorphism.
structure.left_panel: Floating left sidebar (approx 350px width), z-index 40, for KPIs and Event Queue. 16px margin from edges.
structure.right_panel: Floating right sidebar (approx 350px width), z-index 40, for Event Detail and controls. 16px margin from edges.
structure.footer: Floating at the bottom, full width minus margins, thin status bar for health indicators.

layout.spacing: Dense, utilitarian. gap-4, p-4, tight margins to maximize map visibility.
layout.border_radius: Sharp to slight rounding. Use rounded-md (6px) or rounded-lg (8px) max. Avoid pill shapes unless for specific tags.

buttons.style: Flat, sharp edges or 6px radius. 1px border.
buttons.hover: Slight brightness increase, no dramatic scaling to keep it professional.

kpi_cards.style: Grid border layout (border-r border-b border-white/10). Mono font for numbers, large (text-3xl tracking-tight).

event_queue_item.style: Compact list item, border-l-2 based on event status color. Darker background on hover.
event_queue_item.iconography: Lucide icons indicating event type. Small, high contrast.

live_indicator.style: Pulsing dot animation using keyframes (animate-pulse) next to 'LIVE' mono text. Color: cyan or red depending on data feed status.

iconography.usage_rules: Use solid, clear strokes. 16px or 20px sizes.

motion_and_interactions.radar_scanner: Subtle radar sweeping animation on map overlays or loading states.
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: bg-white/5 for row hover states in event queue. Ensure high contrast focus rings (ring-1 ring-white/30).

user_avatar.description: User avatar for the header profile dropdown.

map_placeholder.description: Fallback texture if MapLibre tiles are loading.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `maplibre-gl` for the main map interface. The map MUST cover the entire background.
Install specified fonts (Outfit, Manrope, IBM Plex Mono) via Google Fonts in index.html.
All panels (header, sidebar, footer) MUST float over the map using absolute/fixed positioning with glassmorphism (`bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10`).
Implement the left sidebar for KPIs and Event Queue, and the right sidebar for Event Details and Layer toggles.
Use strict color coding for event severity (red for accidents, amber for construction, purple for congestion, orange for danger).
Use `IBM Plex Mono` for all metric values, numbers, and coordinates.
Add a pulsing 'LIVE' indicator in the header to emphasize real-time data connection.
Implement the footer as a dense status bar showing the health of the 3 data sources (DGT 3.0, SCT, OSM).
Do NOT use pure black or pure white everywhere; rely on `#0A0A0A` for base and `#FFFFFF` for primary text.
Add a 'Measure' (Ruler) tool toggle button in the map controls.
Ensure the UI feels like Palantir Foundry or Mapbox Studio: technical, data-dense, and highly operational.
